27.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve - Tubeless-Ventil - 2er Set - 40 mm | BIKE24
27.evidenceText: Five sources analyzed: One standalone Clik Valve product (p1859948.html), two inner tube products with Clik Valve (p1960182.html, p1960181.html - accessories), one conversion kit with pump head adapter (p1859953.html - accessory), and one category page (marken/schwalbe/f.serie.schwalbe-clik-valve - not a product listing).
27.extractionRationale: Only https://www.bike24.de/p1859948.html represents a distinct standalone Clik Valve product listing. The other URLs are either inner tubes (accessories in different product category), conversion kits (accessories), or category pages. Following the instruction to exclude duplicate listings and accessories, only 1 distinct Clik Valve product listing was found.

30.extractionRationale: All four product listing sources (bike24.com) have empty content sections with no text available to assess stock status. Stock status cannot be determined from the provided evidence.

56.evidenceText: The provided evidence includes references to Schwalbe tubes with Clik valve compatibility (Source 3 mentions "TUBE, AEROTHAN, Schwalbe, 20 Zoll, CARGO/BMX") but the content is incomplete/truncated and does not provide a comprehensive listing of distinct inner tube models/SKUs.
56.extractionRationale: The sources describe the Clik Valve technology and mention some tube references, but do not provide a complete, countable list of distinct Schwalbe inner tube models/SKUs using the Clik valve interface. Source 3 (the most relevant URL for tube products) has truncated content. Sources 1, 2, and 5 discuss valve technology generally. Source 4 lists valve accessories and parts, which are explicitly excluded from this count.

61.extractionRationale: Source 2 confirms that LME aluminum prices are quoted in US$ per tonne (the correct unit), but no specific current price value is provided in the evidence excerpt.
